newsitem.title: USA: Q4 Japan chip market foreign share 29.4 pct - USTR.
newsitem.headline: Q4 Japan chip market foreign share 29.4 pct - USTR.

text.p: The foreign share of Japan's semiconductor market jumped to 29.4 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 from 27.1 percent in the third quarter but was a shade below Q4 1995's 29.6 percent record level, the office of the U.S. Trade Representative said on Thursday.
Foreign share for the whole of 1996 averaged 27.5 percent, up from 1995's 25.4 percent average, USTR said in a statement.

"Progress in market access for foreign semiconductor suppliers in Japan will continue to be important for this administration and is underscored by our 1996 U.S.-Japan Semiconductor Agreement," USTR Charlene Barshefsky said.

"Cooperative activities are the key to achieving improved market access. We will continue to watch the situation closely to ensure that terms of the 1996 agreement continue to be fulfilled," she added.
